Review release readiness for the exact intended commit and environment. Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and the Release Guardian agent.

Verify branch/tag, reviews, required checks, artifact provenance/digest, dependency/security status, migrations, backups, configuration, environment protections, deployment permissions, health checks, monitoring, and rollback/forward-recovery. Distinguish verified facts from unchecked assumptions. Do not deploy or publish. Return go/no-go/conditional recommendation with evidence and owner actions.
